correctness.rationale: Exact Fraisse one-point realization gives all and only lower-set traces. The glued Boolean-cube root recurrence is exact. A strong induction in width and intact-cube count computes every 0/1-end-cube state, with a strict upper bound for boundary queries and balanced optimum among full-cube queries; establishes w-1+floor(log2(h+1)) for all positive integers. Width yields VC dimension w, and exact integer inequalities prove the first height-five entropy loss. A separate literal ideal-space checker cross-validates 28 small instances; no finite-to-infinite inference is made.
